cases.title: Logo completes then game remains on white screen

symptomFingerprint.primary: startup reaches/passes logo then white screen and does not progress into normal game flow
secondary: recenter/input path may still respond while presentation/game progression is stuck
logSignals: correlate game/host/watchdog session timeline around first post-logo Present and stereo transport activation

knownGood: a9abb85702925aaa09ca85581423eb9766c2adb3 — logo/menu/car/course/race rendered; later theater-only VR defect remained
750453f2d2ee357f7ca705e9982907a1578f8fbf — user reached playable road scene; persistent startup white-screen blocker absent in this runtime test

rootCause.summary: D3D9Ex synchronous CreateDevice-thread stereo installation called EnsureStereoResources before the promoted device was returned to OutRun, allocating/mutating private RT/depth resources before fresh-device initialization completed.

fixReferences: 986f0d5794476056ef4bea08c6ac3c0d1f5f01d2 — historical protection: defer stereo resources until first successful game Present
341bd8027b9595f43c89e31ae1f9cf8783751faa — integrated current-focus reconstruction plus deterministic guard

runtime: confirm logo transitions into menu/game instead of persistent white frame
confirm gameplay stereo opens after deferred initialization
collect standardized OutRun2_VR_ANALYZE_*.zip if failure recurs

cases.nextAction: Protect as baseline invariant. Reopen only if a later candidate again fails to reach gameplay or reproduces persistent white screen.

cases.title: White HUD/text elements remain doubled and head-locked on R50

symptomFingerprint.primary: white HUD/text appears as two images and follows head movement

cases.hypothesis: R50 generic SCREEN_OVERLAY_2D common-ray correction is insufficient for exact white HUD producers; exact SCREEN_HUD ownership/scale/world-lock semantics are still missing or not reached.
cases.nextAction: Identify exact white HUD producer/caller families without widening generic queue ownership; assign explicit SCREEN_HUD semantics and preserve R50 world-stereo invariant.

cases.title: Vehicle rank markers are not world-anchored to their vehicles

symptomFingerprint.primary: non-white 1st/2nd/3rd rank marker renders as one image but follows head movement and is not fixed above the corresponding vehicle
secondary: marker appears to live in HUD space and moves independently from vehicle
white vehicle marker still appears doubled

cases.hypothesis: Marker producer is being treated as screen overlay/HUD instead of WORLD_BILLBOARD with vehicle/world anchor transform.
cases.nextAction: Recover exact marker producer/vehicle anchor transform; classify spatial rank marker as WORLD_BILLBOARD while leaving generic HUD/overlay path unchanged.
